Package io.webagent4j.crawler.api.internal

package io.webagent4j.crawler.api.internal
Shared validation internals for the crawler API and its webagent4j-crawler implementation - currently just HttpHeaderValidation, the one framework-owned definition of a valid caller-supplied crawler HTTP header.

"Internal" by convention, not by Java-enforced access - these types are public because webagent4j-crawler (a separate module depending on this one) must call them, exactly as io.webagent4j.crawler.internal types are public for HttpCrawler's benefit. None of this package is part of the module's supported public API; it is excluded from the API compatibility gate like every other .internal package in this project.
